name: POST /api/leadflow/audit/reversals/preview - The blast radius, before anything commits
description: Computes what one of the four reversible actions would touch, category by category, while an operator is still deciding. ZERO SIDE EFFECTS BY CONTRACT: it reads and counts and does nothing else - no write, no suppression, and deliberately no audit append, because an entry here would record a reversal that never happened, and the only thing worse than an unlogged action is a logged one that did not occur. 200 rather than 201 - it is a computation, not a resource. A NULL COUNT IS NOT ZERO: 'nothing would be touched' and 'we could not find out what would be touched' look identical in a number and are opposites in a decision, so every unreachable upstream yields count null AND a named entry in field_gaps, and `reversible` goes false whenever any category could not be counted - an operator may not approve a blast radius nobody can state. The erasure surfaces come from local configuration so that count is exact and never degrades; identity, relationship and consent counts come from their gateways. audit_entries is always null on purpose: the chain is append-only, so a reversal ADDS to it and a count would imply entries change. QA: this route did not exist until the route-versus-definition audit found ReversibleActionsPanel.tsx calling it against a 404. Behind authenticate and not role-gated, like every other read on this router.

testCases.name: Erasure states an exact blast radius, because the surfaces are local configuration
Withdrawing consent counts the queued enrolments this database can see
NEGATIVE: an action outside the four the panel offers
NEGATIVE: no subject to compute a radius for
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: subject_ref is absent or blank, or action is not one of retract_identity_link, end_relationship, withdraw_consent, start_privacy_erasure. An unknown action is rejected rather than previewed as empty, because a blast radius of 'nothing' for a typo is the one answer an operator must never see before approving a reversal.
the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
